name: doca-structured-tools-contract
description: Not for writing library code (name that library skill). Use this skill whenever another DOCA skill says "prefer the structured tool per doca-structured-tools-contract", or when the user wants a one-shot answer consolidating what multiple manual commands would produce — DOCA env / version / devices / capabilities / validate / host vs DPU state. Trigger even without the phrases "structured tool" or "doca-env --json" — typical phrasings include "is there one command that tells me everything about my DOCA install", "what version is X capability available since", "every PF/VF/SF visible on this BlueField with PCIe address", or "will this pipe pass validate before commit". Refuse and route elsewhere for general DOCA orientation, library API how-to, or install-from-scratch guidance — those belong to the per-library skill, doca-public-knowledge-map, or doca-setup.
